title: Booleans and operators
hints: Each function fits in a single boolean expression built from comparisons (==, !=, <, >=) and the logical operators && and ||.
For the remainder operator, -3 % 2 is -1 in Go, not 1: the result takes the sign of the dividend.
CanVote: age >= 18 && registered. Differ: a != b. IsEven: n%2 == 0, which is safe for negative numbers.
